status: Research reproduction package prepared for author upload to GitHub
title: Code and simulation data for Shielded Rolling-Horizon Optimization for Autonomous Mobile Robot Line-Side Replenishment in Robotic Compact Storage and Retrieval Systems
subject: Engineering
keywords: robotic compact storage and retrieval systems
description: Simulation code, instance configurations, seed-level outputs, per-epoch diagnostics, and statistical analyses for shielded rolling-horizon AMR replenishment. The schedule-based benchmark comprises 1,700 executions, including 30 identified BatchGreedy timing replays. The complete Absolute screening and fixed-weight analysis uses 210 records: 165 new executions and 45 reused stopping-study records. Service-event learning diagnostics are supplied as a separate dataset and are not pooled with the schedule-based benchmark.
data_origin: Synthetic simulation; no industrial trace data or participant data
code_license_metadata: MIT as declared in the supplied pyproject.toml
auxiliary_selection_scope: Recorded feature inputs, selected-pair labels, normalization parameters, trained checkpoint, and evaluator support the offline coverage table. This dataset is excluded from the 1,700 schedule-based executions.
